curve_policy: Plot all nine selected systems. Connect only the observed nondominated points within this selected set; lines do not interpolate unmeasured PER or imply a continuously tunable checkpoint. Mark mixed fusion separately. No new statistical intervals are inferred.
scope: Theoretical encoder+compression MACs at fixed duration, with checkpoint-specific retention calibrated on 2620 test-clean utterances. PER is full-corpus CPU/FP32/batch1/beam20. Actual beam-search decoder counts remain in the separate historical full-corpus archives.
